name: Front-to-Back Leg Swing
steps: Stand beside a wall or chair with your inside hand resting on it and your weight on your inside foot.
Keep your torso tall and core lightly braced while letting your outside leg hang free.
Swing your outside leg smoothly forward and upward to a comfortable height, then sweep it straight backward behind you in a controlled pendulum motion.
Continue swinging smoothly through your comfortable range for the duration on one leg, then turn around and switch sides.
tips: Avoid rounding or aggressively arching your lower back as the leg swings to the front and rear.
Start with small swings and gradually increase the range as your hip flexors and hamstrings warm up.
